component.name: ScreenWatch
component.summary: Watch a screen area and auto-click when it changes

description.p: ScreenWatch continuously monitors a screen area you pick. The instant that area changes visually — a button lights up, a number updates, an image loads, a progress bar finishes — it clicks a location you pick. Both the watched region and the click point are chosen visually, directly on your live, moving screen.

ul.li: Live, non-covering region and point selection — drag over your real screen, not a frozen snapshot
Adjustable sensitivity and a noise filter so flicker doesn't trigger false clicks
Detects colour changes as well as brightness changes
Two detection modes: react to any change, or to a deviation from a starting state
A "Why / Log" view that shows exactly which pixels triggered each click
Customizable global hotkeys to start, stop, and quit
Optimized to run for hours with a very small CPU and memory footprint

screenshot.caption: The Why / Log tab: every click is logged with a picture of exactly what triggered it

description.p: First packaged release: live region/point selection, colour-aware change detection, customizable hotkeys, and the Why/Log detection history.
